A companion to your consultation. This research prototype provides educational information, not diagnosis or prescriptions. The designated image uses a labelled, predefined demo. Other images use written-text matching for kidney stones, fatty liver, arm/wrist fractures and explicitly reported anemia. Scan image diagnosis, PDFs, HEIC and handwriting are unsupported. An empty result does not mean a normal report.
Built for understanding. For review with your doctor.No account, server-side report storage, or external AI calls.
